How many MW of nuclear resource capacity were unavailable due to forced outages in NYISO on October 19, 2026? Exclude planned outages.
What was PJM's average regulation-up ancillary service clearing price on October 18, 2026 local time, in USD/MW-hour? Do not use energy LMPs or other reserve products.

In California's current interconnection queue, what percentage of active solar capacity in MW belongs to solar projects paired with storage? Weight by proposed capacity, not project count; use the is_hybrid flag and include all active solar capacity in the denominator.

What was New England's largest positive hour-to-hour change in actual hourly demand on October 19, 2026 local time, in MW? Compare only consecutive readings whose two hours are both on that local date; use UTC ordering.
What percentage of PJM's generation came from natural gas in September 2026?
For CAISO_HUB on October 21, 2026 from 5 pm to 6 pm local, what was average real-time hub LMP minus day-ahead hourly hub LMP? Report the signed spread in USD/MWh.
What was ERCOT's latest hourly load forecast available at or before October 20, 2026 18:00 UTC for delivery on October 21 at 5 pm local? Report forecast MW.
For SPP delivery at 14:00 local on October 19, 2026, what was the latest load forecast in MW published by October 18, 2026 18:00 UTC?
At ISONE_HUB on October 16, 2026 from noon to 1 pm local, what was mean five-minute real-time hub LMP minus day-ahead hourly hub LMP? Give the signed spread in USD/MWh.
For CAISO delivery at October 21, 2026 15:00 UTC, what was the latest load forecast published at or before October 21, 2026 09:00 UTC? Include a publication exactly at the cutoff. Report MW.
What was CAISO's net battery energy output in MWh on October 21, 2026 local time? Integrate discharge minus charging, using five-minute dispatch, rather than reporting gross discharge.
How much wind energy was curtailed in SPP on October 20, 2026 local time, in MWh? Integrate five-minute curtailed power, not generated output.

For CAISO on October 21, 2026 local time, find the hour with the highest signed real-time minus day-ahead hub LMP spread. Average the 12 five-minute real-time hub LMPs within each hour before subtracting that hour's day-ahead hub LMP; negative spreads are allowed. Break ties by the earliest UTC hour. For the winning hour, using the latest load forecast published at or before October 21, 2026 12:00 UTC, what is forecast MW minus actual hourly demand MW? Report the signed error in MW.

For California on October 21, 2026 local time, select the three hours with the highest actual hourly demand, breaking ties by earliest UTC hour. During those hours only, what was the battery fleet's net energy revenue in USD at CAISO_HUB real-time LMPs? Value discharge positively and charging negatively at the matching five-minute hub price. Rank hourly demand first, then align storage and prices by ISO and UTC interval and convert interval MW to MWh before summing. Ignore fees and efficiency losses.

For ERCOT's delivery hours on October 19, 2026 local time, calculate mean absolute load-forecast error in MW using only information published at or before October 19, 2026 00:00 UTC. For each delivery hour choose the latest eligible forecast, then compare with actual hourly demand. Exclude any hour without an eligible forecast; do not average forecast vintages or use the simple demand_forecast_mw field.

For SPP on October 20, 2026 local time, what percentage of available wind energy was curtailed? Define available energy as hourly observed wind-generation energy plus five-minute curtailed wind energy. Convert each series to MWh at its own cadence, aggregate separately, and report 100 times curtailed divided by available.

For California and Texas separately, find each region's highest actual hourly demand on October 19, 2026 local time, breaking ties by earliest UTC hour. At each winning hour calculate wind plus solar generation as a percentage of total net generation across all fuels. Aggregate fuel rows before joining the hourly balance. Report California's percentage minus Texas's percentage in percentage points.

For ERCOT on October 18, 2026 local time, find the hour of highest actual hourly demand minus hourly wind and solar generation. Aggregate the two fuels before joining demand, and break ties by earliest UTC hour. For that winning hour, report average five-minute real-time HUB LMP minus matching day-ahead HUB LMP, in USD/MWh. Use hourly generation and demand, not five-minute load or generation.

Compare the mean energy-price component (energy, not total LMP) for real-time bus, real-time hub and day-ahead hub series across all seven ISOs for October 15–21, 2026, inclusive in each ISO's local time. Average all native-interval observations for each ISO/product; for bus series pool the three buses with equal observation weights. Return all 21 combinations as columns iso_code, product, average_energy_price in USD/MWh. Use product labels real_time_bus, real_time_hub, and day_ahead_hub; do not omit a region or product or substitute a missing-series claim.

WITH hourly AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
           avg(load_mw) AS demand_mw
    FROM core.fact_load_5min
    WHERE iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'ISONE')
      AND CAST(interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
    GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc)
), changes AS (
    SELECT demand_mw - lag(demand_mw) OVER (ORDER BY hour_utc) AS change_mw
    FROM hourly
)
SELECT max(change_mw) AS largest_positive_hour_to_hour_change_mw
FROM changes
WHERE change_mw > 0

WITH hourly AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
           avg(load_mw) AS demand_mw,
           count(*) AS five_min_rows
    FROM core.fact_load_5min
    WHERE iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'ISONE')
      AND CAST(interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
    GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc)
), ordered AS (
    SELECT hour_utc, demand_mw, five_min_rows,
           lag(hour_utc) OVER (ORDER BY hour_utc) AS prev_hour_utc,
           lag(demand_mw) OVER (ORDER BY hour_utc) AS prev_demand_mw
    FROM hourly
)
SELECT max(demand_mw - prev_demand_mw) FILTER (WHERE hour_utc - prev_hour_utc = INTERVAL '1 hour') AS largest_positive_hour_to_hour_change_mw
FROM ordered
WHERE prev_demand_mw IS NOT NULL AND hour_utc - prev_hour_utc = INTERVAL '1 hour'
  AND demand_mw > prev_demand_mw

SELECT min(interval_start_local) AS first_local, max(interval_start_local) AS last_local, count(*) AS rows, count(load_mw) AS nonnull_loads FROM core.fact_load_5min WHERE iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code='ISONE')

WITH readings AS (
    SELECT
        b.interval_start_utc,
        b.demand_mw,
        LAG(b.demand_mw) OVER (ORDER BY b.interval_start_utc) AS prior_demand_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ISONE'
      AND b.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00'
      AND b.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
)
SELECT MAX(demand_mw - prior_demand_mw) AS largest_positive_change_mw
FROM readings
WHERE prior_demand_mw IS NOT NULL
  AND demand_mw IS NOT NULL
  AND demand_mw - prior_demand_mw > 0

WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        b.interval_start_utc,
        b.interval_start_local,
        b.demand_mw,
        LAG(b.demand_mw) OVER (ORDER BY b.interval_start_utc) AS previous_demand_mw,
        LAG(b.interval_start_local) OVER (ORDER BY b.interval_start_utc) AS previous_local
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ISONE'
      AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
)
SELECT MAX(demand_mw - previous_demand_mw) AS largest_positive_change_mw
FROM ordered
WHERE CAST(previous_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-19'
  AND demand_mw > previous_demand_mw

SELECT b.demand_mw AS actual_hourly_demand_mw

SELECT b.demand_mw

WITH generation AS (
  SELECT SUM(g.generation_mw) AS generated_mwh
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
    AND f.fuel_code = 'wind'
    AND g.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
    AND g.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
), curtailment AS (
  SELECT SUM(c.curtailed_mw / 12.0) AS curtailed_mwh
  FROM core.spp_renewable_curtailment_5min c
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = c.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = c.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
    AND f.fuel_code = 'wind'
    AND c.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
    AND c.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
)
SELECT 100.0 * c.curtailed_mwh / (g.generated_mwh + c.curtailed_mwh) AS curtailed_percentage
FROM generation g CROSS JOIN curtailment c

WITH generation AS (
    SELECT SUM(g.generation_mw) AS generated_mwh
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
      AND f.fuel_code = 'wind'

), curtailment AS (

    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = c.iso_id
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = c.fuel_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'
      AND f.fuel_code = 'wind'
      AND CAST(c.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
)
SELECT 100.0 * curtailment.curtailed_mwh /
       (generation.generated_mwh + curtailment.curtailed_mwh) AS curtailed_pct_available
FROM generation CROSS JOIN curtailment

WITH wind AS (
    SELECT fuel_id

    WHERE fuel_code = 'wind'
), generated AS (

    JOIN wind AS f ON f.fuel_id = c.fuel_id

)
SELECT 100.0 * curtailed.curtailed_mwh /

FROM generated CROSS JOIN curtailed

        / NULLIF(SUM(b.net_generation_mw), 0) AS natural_gas_generation_pct
FROM core.dim_iso AS i
JOIN core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    ON g.iso_id = b.iso_id

  AND b.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'

WITH gen AS (
  SELECT SUM(g.generation_mw) AS gas_mw
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'PJM'
    AND f.fuel_code = 'natural_gas'
    AND g.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
    AND g.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
), total AS (
  SELECT SUM(b.net_generation_mw) AS total_mw
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'PJM'

    AND b.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01 00:00:00'

 AND b.interval_start_utc = g.interval_start_utc

WITH hourly_gen AS (
    SELECT g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc,
           SUM(g.generation_mw) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT'
      AND f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar')
      AND g.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 00:00:00'
      AND g.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
), hourly_net AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.interval_start_local,
           b.demand_mw - h.wind_solar_mw AS demand_minus_wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    JOIN core.dim_iso AS i ON i.iso_id = b.iso_id
    JOIN hourly_gen AS h ON h.iso_id = b.iso_id AND h.interval_start_utc = b.interval_start_utc
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'ERCOT'
      AND b.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 00:00:00'
      AND b.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00'
), winner AS (
    SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc, interval_start_local
    FROM hourly_net
    ORDER BY demand_minus_wind_solar_mw DESC, interval_start_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1
), rt AS (
    SELECT r.iso_id, r.interval_start_utc, AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp
    FROM core.ercot_lmp_rt_hub_5min AS r
    JOIN core.dim_location AS l ON l.location_id = r.location_id
    WHERE l.location_code = 'ERCOT_HUB'
    GROUP BY r.iso_id, r.interval_start_utc
)
SELECT AVG(rt.rt_avg_lmp - da.lmp) AS numeric_answer
FROM winner AS w
JOIN rt ON rt.iso_id = w.iso_id
       AND rt.interval_start_utc >= w.interval_start_utc
       AND rt.interval_start_utc < w.interval_start_utc + INTERVAL '1 hour'
JOIN core.ercot_lmp_da_hub_hourly AS da
  ON da.iso_id = w.iso_id
 AND da.interval_start_utc = w.interval_start_utc
JOIN core.dim_location AS lda ON lda.location_id = da.location_id
WHERE lda.location_code = 'ERCOT_HUB'

WITH fuel_ids AS (

),
renewables_by_hour AS (

    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g

      AND g.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc,
           b.demand_mw - r.wind_solar_mw AS residual_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.demand_mw - r.wind_solar_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN renewables_by_hour r ON b.iso_id = r.iso_id AND b.interval_start_utc = r.interval_start_utc
    WHERE b.iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'ERCOT')
      AND b.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 00:00:00'
      AND b.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00'
),
rt_by_hour AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id, DATE_TRUNC('hour', p.interval_start_utc) AS interval_start_utc,
           AVG(p.lmp) AS avg_rt_lmp
    FROM core.ercot_lmp_rt_hub_5min p
    JOIN core.dim_location l ON p.location_id = l.location_id
    WHERE l.location_code = 'ERCOT_HUB'
      AND p.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 00:00:00'
      AND p.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY p.iso_id, DATE_TRUNC('hour', p.interval_start_utc)
),
da AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc, AVG(p.lmp) AS da_lmp
    FROM core.ercot_lmp_da_hub_hourly p
    JOIN core.dim_location l ON p.location_id = l.location_id
    WHERE l.location_code = 'ERCOT_HUB'
      AND p.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 00:00:00'
      AND p.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc
)
SELECT rt.avg_rt_lmp - da.da_lmp AS numeric_answer
FROM ranked h
JOIN rt_by_hour rt ON rt.iso_id = h.iso_id AND rt.interval_start_utc = h.interval_start_utc
JOIN da ON da.iso_id = h.iso_id AND da.interval_start_utc = h.interval_start_utc
WHERE h.rn = 1

WITH hourly_fuels AS (
    SELECT g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind', 'solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw
    FROM core.fact_generation_hourly AS g
    JOIN core.dim_fuel AS f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
    WHERE g.iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'ERCOT')

    GROUP BY g.iso_id, g.interval_start_utc
), candidates AS (
    SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc,
           b.demand_mw - h.wind_solar_mw AS residual_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
    JOIN hourly_fuels AS h
      ON h.iso_id = b.iso_id AND h.interval_start_utc = b.interval_start_utc
    WHERE b.iso_id = (SELECT iso_id FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code = 'ERCOT')
      AND b.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 00:00:00'

), winner AS (
    SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc

), rt AS (

    FROM core.ercot_lmp_rt_hub_5min AS r
    JOIN core.dim_location AS l ON l.location_id = r.location_id
    JOIN winner AS w ON w.iso_id = r.iso_id
      AND r.interval_start_utc >= w.interval_start_utc
      AND r.interval_start_utc < w.interval_start_utc + INTERVAL '1 hour'
    WHERE l.location_code = 'ERCOT_HUB'
    GROUP BY r.interval_start_utc
), rt_hour AS (
    SELECT AVG(rt_avg_lmp) AS avg_rt_lmp
    FROM rt
), da AS (
    SELECT d.lmp AS da_lmp
    FROM core.ercot_lmp_da_hub_hourly AS d

)
SELECT rt_hour.avg_rt_lmp - da.da_lmp AS answer
FROM rt_hour CROSS JOIN da

WITH rt_hourly AS (
    SELECT p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc, p.location_id,
           date_trunc('hour', p.interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
           avg(p.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp,
           count(*) AS rt_intervals
    FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min p
    JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id = p.location_id
    WHERE l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
      AND p.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
      AND p.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc, p.location_id
), spread AS (
    SELECT r.hour_utc, r.rt_avg_lmp, d.lmp AS da_lmp,
           r.rt_avg_lmp - d.lmp AS spread
    FROM rt_hourly r
    JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly d
      ON d.iso_id = r.iso_id
     AND d.interval_start_utc = r.hour_utc
     AND d.location_id = r.location_id
), winner AS (
    SELECT hour_utc
    FROM spread
    ORDER BY spread DESC, hour_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1
), forecast AS (
    SELECT f.interval_start_utc, f.forecast_mw,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.interval_start_utc ORDER BY f.publish_time_utc DESC) AS rn
    FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly f
    JOIN winner w ON f.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc
    WHERE f.publish_time_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00'
), actual AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
           avg(load_mw) AS actual_mw,
           count(*) AS intervals
    FROM core.fact_load_5min
    JOIN core.dim_iso i USING (iso_id)
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', interval_start_utc)
)
SELECT f.forecast_mw - a.actual_mw AS forecast_minus_actual_mw
FROM winner w
JOIN forecast f ON f.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc AND f.rn = 1
JOIN actual a ON a.hour_utc = w.hour_utc

WITH rt_hour AS (
  SELECT r.iso_id, r.location_id, date_trunc('hour', r.interval_start_utc) AS hour_utc,
         AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min AS r
  JOIN core.dim_location AS l ON l.location_id = r.location_id
  WHERE r.iso_id = 1
    AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
    AND r.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
    AND r.interval_start_local <  TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY r.iso_id, r.location_id, date_trunc('hour', r.interval_start_utc)
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 12
), spreads AS (
  SELECT rt.iso_id, rt.location_id, rt.hour_utc,
         rt.rt_avg_lmp - da.lmp AS spread
  FROM rt_hour AS rt
  JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly AS da
    ON da.iso_id = rt.iso_id AND da.location_id = rt.location_id AND da.interval_start_utc = rt.hour_utc
  WHERE da.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
    AND da.interval_start_local <  TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
), winner AS (
  SELECT iso_id, hour_utc
  FROM spreads
  ORDER BY spread DESC, hour_utc ASC
  LIMIT 1
), forecast AS (
  SELECT f.forecast_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.iso_id, f.interval_start_utc ORDER BY f.publish_time_utc DESC) AS rn
  FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly AS f
  JOIN winner AS w ON w.iso_id = f.iso_id AND w.hour_utc = f.interval_start_utc
  WHERE f.publish_time_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00'
), actual AS (
  SELECT b.demand_mw
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly AS b
  JOIN winner AS w ON w.iso_id = b.iso_id AND w.hour_utc = b.interval_start_utc
)
SELECT f.forecast_mw - a.demand_mw AS answer_mw
FROM forecast AS f CROSS JOIN actual AS a
WHERE f.rn = 1

WITH rt AS (
    SELECT h.interval_start_utc AS hour_utc,
           AVG(m.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp,
           COUNT(*) AS rt_intervals
    FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min m
    JOIN core.dim_location l ON m.location_id = l.location_id
    JOIN core.dim_iso i ON m.iso_id = i.iso_id
    JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly h
      ON m.iso_id = h.iso_id
     AND date_trunc('hour', m.interval_start_utc) = h.interval_start_utc
     AND m.location_id = h.location_id
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
      AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
      AND m.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
      AND m.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
      AND h.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
      AND h.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY h.interval_start_utc
), spreads AS (
    SELECT rt.hour_utc, rt.rt_avg_lmp - da.lmp AS spread,
           rt.rt_intervals
    FROM rt
    JOIN core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly da
      ON da.interval_start_utc = rt.hour_utc
     AND da.iso_id = 1
    JOIN core.dim_location l ON da.location_id = l.location_id
    WHERE l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
), winner AS (
    SELECT hour_utc
    FROM spreads
    ORDER BY spread DESC, hour_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1
), forecast AS (
    SELECT f.forecast_mw,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.interval_start_utc ORDER BY f.publish_time_utc DESC) AS rn
    FROM core.caiso_load_forecast_hourly f
    JOIN winner w ON f.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc
    WHERE f.publish_time_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 12:00:00'
), actual AS (
    SELECT b.demand_mw
    FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
    JOIN core.dim_iso i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
    JOIN winner w ON b.interval_start_utc = w.hour_utc
    WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
)
SELECT f.forecast_mw - a.demand_mw AS signed_forecast_error_mw
FROM forecast f CROSS JOIN actual a
